newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombian peso ends 2.6 pesos lower vs dollar.
newsitem.headline: Colombian peso ends 2.6 pesos lower vs dollar.

text.p: Colombia's peso ended 2.6 pesos lower against the dollar at 1,064.60 in trading that saw steady demand for U.S. currency from banks and other financial institutions, interbank dealers said.
They said the market was highly liquid in terms of pesos and that this was expected to continue providing short-term support for the dollar.
"There was very little real supply or demand," one dealer said of Wednesday's trade. "The only real business going on involved banks that were recovering their dollar positions."
Dealers reported a lackluster total of $157 million in trading and said the peso held in a 1,061.50-to-1,065 range.
